attchmntText: GE Power India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation for update of contact details of Key Managerial Personnels under Regulation 30(5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations )'.
voiceSummary: GE Power India Limited has updated the contact details of its Key Managerial Personnel effective 13 November 2026. The designated personnel include Mr. Puneet Bhatla, Managing Director; Mr. Shrikar Thakur, Whole-time Director; Mr. Vipul Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer; and Mr. Rahul Rojal, Chief Financial Officer. The updated address for Mr. Bhatla is Axis House, Plot No. 1-14, Towers 5 and 6, Jaypee Wish Town, Sector 128, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, 201304. His contact number is 0120-5011011 and email is in.investor-relations@gevernova.com. This information is provided in compliance with Regulation 30(5) of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: GE Power India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: GE Power India Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 on 13 November 2026. The Board noted the Limited Review Report issued by Deloitte Haskins & Sells. For the six months ended 30 September 2026, the company reported a net profit of 853.4 million rupees, compared to 620.4 million rupees in the same period of 2025. Revenue from operations stood at 6,199.2 million rupees, up from 5,672.5 million rupees in the prior year. Basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations and discontinued operations were 12.70 rupees, compared to 9.23 rupees in the previous year. The results are available on the company website.
